Then, within that group, keep those who are also above the group's own average, noting how far above that they are. WITH p AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB * 1.0 / HCT) AS r
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0 AND HGB IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
),
o AS (
    SELECT AVG(r) AS a FROM p
),
g1 AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.r, p.r - o.a AS d1
    FROM p, o
    WHERE p.r > o.a
),
g2 AS (
    SELECT AVG(r) AS a2 FROM g1
),
f AS (
    SELECT g1.ID, g1.r, g1.d1, g1.r - g2.a2 AS d2
    FROM g1, g2
    WHERE g1.r > g2.a2
)
SELECT AVG(r) AS avg_ratio, AVG(d1) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(d2) AS avg_above_group
FROM f;
WITH r AS (
    SELECT ID, Date, HGB / HCT AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0
),
g1 AS (
    SELECT ID, Date, ratio, ratio - (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM r) AS diff_overall
    FROM r
    WHERE ratio > (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM r)
),
g2 AS (
    SELECT ID, Date, ratio, diff_overall, ratio - (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM g1) AS diff_group
    FROM g1
    WHERE ratio > (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM g1)
)
SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(diff_overall) AS avg_diff_overall,
       AVG(diff_group) AS avg_diff_group
FROM g2;
WITH r AS (
  SELECT ID, SUM(HGB) * 1.0 / SUM(HCT) AS ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
  HAVING SUM(HCT) <> 0
),
o AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall_avg FROM r
),
a AS (
  SELECT r.ID, r.ratio, r.ratio - o.overall_avg AS above_overall
  FROM r, o
  WHERE r.ratio > o.overall_avg
),
g AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS group_avg FROM a
),
f AS (
  SELECT a.ID, a.ratio, a.above_overall, a.ratio - g.group_avg AS above_group
  FROM a, g
  WHERE a.ratio > g.group_avg
)
SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(above_overall) AS avg_above_overall,
       AVG(above_group) AS avg_above_group
FROM f;
WITH ratios AS (
    SELECT ID, Date, HGB * 1.0 / HCT AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT != 0 AND HGB IS NOT NULL AND HGB != 0
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_all FROM ratios
),
above_all AS (
    SELECT r.ID, r.Date, r.ratio, r.ratio - o.avg_all AS diff_overall
    FROM ratios r, overall o
    WHERE r.ratio > o.avg_all
),
grp AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_grp FROM above_all
),
final AS (
    SELECT a.ratio, a.diff_overall, a.ratio - g.avg_grp AS diff_group
    FROM above_all a, grp g
    WHERE a.ratio > g.avg_grp
)
SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       AVG(diff_overall) AS avg_diff_overall,
       AVG(diff_group) AS avg_diff_group
FROM final;
